item.title: London to face Rome, Munich and Nairobi after confirming 2029 World Athletics bid
item.summary: Bid team reach agreement with West Ham to use stadium Host city for event to be announced in September London has submitted its bid for the 2029 World Athletics ­Championships after reaching an agreement with West Ham to allow it to host the event that September. World Athletics is yet to announce the other candidate cities, but Rome, Munich and Nairobi have also ­submitted applications for 2029. Continue reading...
